name: Can a listing agent help me with home staging or repairs?

mainEntity.name: Can a listing agent help me with home staging or repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: While listing agents don't typically perform staging or repairs themselves, they can provide valuable guidance and recommendations. Many agents have a network of trusted professionals, such as stagers, contractors, and handymen, whom they can refer to you. They will advise on which improvements will yield the best return on investment and help your home appeal to a wider range of buyers. This preparation can be crucial in competitive markets like Key Biscayne or Pinecrest.
acceptedAnswer.description: Listing agents can advise on home staging and repairs, and refer trusted professionals to help prepare your home for sale.
